requirement: Ops demos and listing: one press gives one demo job, a failed copy is torn down before a retry, removals settle, Listing unlocks from the Road, and Create listing no longer hangs on a third-party request

oracle.invariant: After a failed job, a new install holds every press until the new job is known, and a 409 DEMO_BUSY is printed without following anything. A second install while one is in flight is refused by name and starts nothing; two installs arriving together start one job. A retry after a failed install tears the broken copy down first, then provisions the new one. The stale-copy refusal has a short guide and the card offers Remove; two presses send one DELETE; other failures keep Retry install alone. A removal reads Removing while it runs and Not installed once done, also when the server no longer knows the job, and a screen opened mid-removal reads it as a removal from deployed.kind. Once the demo is live the next page read unlocks the Listing card, following the same road the Road to live shows. Generate card answers a Tracy reason (424 OUTLINE_FAILED) when the host cannot read the demo or never answers, never a bare gateway status, and the harness says it in words. A model that fails, times out or never answers still returns the layouts that were read, with category and blurb empty and a why. tracy-host outlines and shoots a page whose load never fires from its DOM with bounded waits, instead of failing at the goto limit.
